title: E2E: pwm-coding delegates Rust edit to local pwm_editor
brief: Vertical slice: coding worker must NOT edit files directly. Delegate bump of cqds-delegation-smoke v2→v3 via cq_companion_ctl#subagent_call → pwm_editor (pi/Ollama). Coding worker verifies and submits.
acceptance_criteria: All Rust edits performed only through subagent_call to worker_id pwm_editor
crates/cqds-delegation-smoke/src/lib.rs: delegation_ping -> ok-v3, delegation_version -> 3, tests updated

delegation.invite_note:
E2E DELEGATION SMOKE — editor_delegation: required

Do NOT use cq_files_ctl replace/edit on this slice.

1) Read crates/cqds-delegation-smoke/src/lib.rs (current v2 / ok-v2).
2) cq_companion_ctl subagent_call worker_id=pwm_editor timeout_sec=300 with task: bump delegation_ping to "ok-v3", delegation_version to 3, fix unit tests in same file only. Absolute path P:/opt/docker/pwm-protocol/crates/cqds-delegation-smoke/src/lib.rs
3) Poll subagent_poll if pending.
4) Verify on disk + cargo test -p cqds-delegation-smoke via cq_exec.
5) Submit PASS with editor_delegation and subagent_calls in result_payload.
